```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(kknn)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(smotefamily)

```

```{r}
# Load data
df <- read.csv("../data/clean_train.csv")
df$Credit_Score <- as.factor(df$Credit_Score)

```

```{r}
# Drop high-cardinality categorical columns
df_knn <- df %>%
  select(-Customer_ID, -Month, -Occupation, -Credit_Mix, 
         -Payment_of_Min_Amount, -Payment_Behaviour)

```

```{r}
set.seed(5003)

# Separate predictors and response
X <- df_knn[, -ncol(df_knn)]
y <- df_knn$Credit_Score

# Apply SMOTE
smote_result <- SMOTE(X, y, K = 5)

# SMOTE returns a dataframe in smote_result$data, with last column as 'class'
df_balanced <- smote_result$data
df_balanced$Credit_Score <- as.factor(df_balanced$class)
df_balanced$class <- NULL  # Remove redundant column

```

```{r}
# Split data into training and test sets
set.seed(5003)
split_idx <- createDataPartition(df_balanced$Credit_Score, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_kknn <- df_balanced[split_idx, ]
test_kknn <- df_balanced[-split_idx, ]

```

```{r}
# Scale numerical data
preproc <- preProcess(train_kknn[, -ncol(train_kknn)], method = c("center", "scale"))
train_scaled <- predict(preproc, train_kknn[, -ncol(train_kknn)])
test_scaled <- predict(preproc, test_kknn[, -ncol(test_kknn)])

train_scaled$Credit_Score <- train_kknn$Credit_Score
test_scaled$Credit_Score <- test_kknn$Credit_Score

```

```{r}
# Train weighted KNN using kknn
set.seed(5003)
kknn_model <- train.kknn(Credit_Score ~ ., data = train_scaled,
                         ks = 1:21, kernel = "triangular", distance = 2)

# View best model details
summary(kknn_model)
plot(kknn_model)

```
```{r}
kknn_model
```
```{r}
# Training Accuracy and Kappa
train_pred <- predict(kknn_model, train_scaled)
train_acc <- mean(train_pred == train_scaled$Credit_Score)
print(paste("Training Accuracy:", round(train_acc, 4)))

train_cm <- confusionMatrix(train_pred, train_scaled$Credit_Score)
train_cm
train_cm$overall['Kappa']

```

```{r}
# Predict on test data
pred_kknn <- predict(kknn_model, test_scaled)

# Accuracy
acc_kknn <- mean(pred_kknn == test_scaled$Credit_Score)
print(paste("Test Accuracy:", round(acc_kknn, 4)))

# Confusion Matrix
confusionMatrix(pred_kknn, test_scaled$Credit_Score)

```

```{r}
# AUC (requires numeric response)
auc_kknn <- multiclass.roc(test_scaled$Credit_Score, as.numeric(pred_kknn))
auc_kknn$auc

```
```{r}
# Generate confusion matrix on test data
cm_test <- confusionMatrix(pred_kknn, test_scaled$Credit_Score)

# Extract per-class metrics
precision <- round(cm_test$byClass[, "Precision"], 4)
recall <- round(cm_test$byClass[, "Recall"], 4)
f1 <- round(cm_test$byClass[, "F1"], 4)

# Calculate macro-averaged scores
macro_precision <- round(mean(precision, na.rm = TRUE), 4)
macro_recall <- round(mean(recall, na.rm = TRUE), 4)
macro_f1 <- round(mean(f1, na.rm = TRUE), 4)

# Overall accuracy and AUC
accuracy <- round(cm_test$overall["Accuracy"], 4)
auc <- round(auc_kknn$auc, 4)

# Create results table
results_table <- data.frame(
  Class = rownames(cm_test$byClass),
  Precision = precision,
  Recall = recall,
  F1_Score = f1,
  Accuracy = NA,
  AUC = NA
)

# Append Overall/Macro row
overall_metrics <- data.frame(
  Class = "Overall (Macro Avg)",
  Precision = macro_precision,
  Recall = macro_recall,
  F1_Score = macro_f1,
  Accuracy = accuracy,
  AUC = auc
)

# Final table
results_table <- rbind(results_table, overall_metrics)

# Display the table
knitr::kable(results_table, caption = "KNN Model Performance on Test Data")

```


```{r}
saveRDS(kknn_model, "kknn_model.rds")
```
